description: For an IPv4 prefix (e.g. 8.8.8.0/24): the origin AS seen announcing it now across RIPE RIS peers, its RPKI status for that origin (valid, invalid or unknown), route objects, visibility, and how many more-specific and less-specific prefixes are seen. An 'invalid' RPKI status is a hijack warning sign; it is not proof of a hijack. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

prefix.description: IPv4 prefix in CIDR form, e.g. 8.8.8.0/24 (required)
